text:
Elena: Heads-up  Orbit QBR scheduled for next Tue 1pm PT. Need: 1-slide health summary, onboarding status, top renewal risk (one line), and a single exec ask. Drop bullets here by Fri EOD.

Raj: I'll own the health slide. Planning to show p95 latency, active seats, and a tiny trend for embeddings adoption (last 60d).

Marta: I'll do onboarding. Current cohort: 10 accounts: 7 green, 2 blocked (schema mapping), 1 waiting legal sign-off. Will add owner names and ETAs.

Devon: Renewal signals: one strategic account trending low NPS after a failed exec demo last week. I'll draft the one-liner.

PriyaCS: Exec ask suggestion: "Approve 6-week pilot Dedicated pool for priority accounts + 40 hrs SE time." I'll draft impact bullets (expected reduction in demo failures and time-to-resolution).

Elena: Good. Keep the risk blurb to one sentence + one mitigation bullet. Also include a fallback option if pilot isn't approved.

Devon: "Renewal risk: RED  one strategic account experienced repeated demo failures during exec POC; mitigation: canary Dedicated pool and prioritized SE triage."

Raj: For metrics I'll include cost delta for the pilot and a before/after p95 row. Does anyone want route-level callouts?

Marta: Yes call out embeddings.sync and data.connect. Embeddings adoption lags on accounts that had connector errors.

PriyaCS: Fallback if denied: increase retries + demo-run checklist + temporary routing to lower-latency region for demos. I'll add that as a single-row table.

Elena: Logistics: deck link -> https://drive.redwood/orbit-qbr-cruise (please add slides by Mon noon); dry run Mon 4pm PT. calendar-bot will post invites.

calendar-bot: Created event: Orbit QBR dry run  Mon 16:00 PT. Invitees: Elena, Raj, Marta, Devon, PriyaCS.

Raj: I'll attach a small heatmap for error classes and a one-liner customer quote: "response quality strong but demo reliability inconsistent" (anonymized).

Marta: Onboarding ETAs: schema mapping fixes = 7 business days with SE; legal = 10 business days. I'll tag SE and Legal owners in the Drive slide.

Devon: Uploaded the incident notes and the timeline of demo failures. I'll include screenshots from the logs (redacted).

PriyaCS: Exec ask slide: objective, ask (pilot + SE hours), expected impact (demo pass rate + renewal uplift), rough cost. Keep it to 3 bullets.

Elena: Quick decision point  do we want to include a small ROI calc (probability-weighted renewal lift) or keep it qualitative? Execs usually like a number.

PriyaCS: I'll add a single-row ROI calc: expected incremental ARR vs pilot cost, using conservative uplift.

Raj: Added charts and highlighted routes: text.generate, embeddings.sync.

Marta: Added onboarding owner matrix and next steps.

Devon: Sent final risk blurb and mitigation into the Drive doc.

Elena: Recap: slides in Drive by Mon noon; dry run Mon 4pm PT; final deck to exec Tue 11am PT. If anyone can't make the dry run, DM me with notes. Thanks team :thumbsup:
